title.purpose: Fire name in the detail-panel header; the single largest text on the page.

body.purpose: Stat values, panel copy, chart tooltips, badge text.

label.purpose: Uppercase section eyebrows ("MEIOS NO TERRENO", "SEVERIDADE") and the ad-slot micro-label.

shadows.name: chrome-lift
shadows.purpose: Secondary lift on floating chrome (top bar, legend) so edges separate from busy map content; not the primary depth cue.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Secondary lift on the detail panel; paired with glass translucency, not a replacement for it.

shadows.name: heatmap-glow-underlay
shadows.purpose: Wide, soft glow pass beneath the sharp heatmap core — the map's real depth/urgency cue, not a shadow.

shadows.name: polygon-line-glow
shadows.purpose: Blurred glow line under the solid burned-area polygon stroke.

motion.name: panel-slide
motion.purpose: Detail panel slide-in/out (translate-y on mobile, translate-x on desktop).

motion.name: toggle-slide
motion.purpose: Theme-toggle thumb sliding between light/dark positions.

components.name: Status Badge (Active)
components.description: Full-pill status indicator reading "Ativo"; always paired with a neutral severity pill beside it.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-active { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15); color: #ef4444; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(239,68,68,0.4); }

components.name: Status Badge (Contained)
components.css: .ds-badge-contained { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color: #f59e0b; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(245,158,11,0.4); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

components.name: Status Badge (Extinguished)
components.description: Full-pill status indicator reading "Extinto" — the one place Resolved Emerald appears.
components.css: .ds-badge-extinguished { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color: #10b981; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(16,185,129,0.4); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Full-round track with a sliding circular thumb carrying a sun/moon SVG icon; the only interactive control in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; height: 36px; width: 64px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #262c37; background: #1a1f28; } .ds-toggle-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; height: 28px; width: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(232,234,237,0.9); color: #0a0d12; transform: translateX(28px); transition: transform 0.2s ease; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

components.name: Ad Slot
components.description: Deliberately recessive placeholder ad unit — dashed border, muted fill, centered uppercase micro-label. Never styled like a data card.
components.css: .ds-adslot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px dashed #262c37; background: rgba(26,31,40,0.6); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgba(232,234,237,0.4); width: 100%; max-width: 300px; height: 250px; margin: 0 auto; }

components.name: Detail Panel Stat Card
components.description: Recessed 2-column stat grid used for the "Meios no terreno" (forces) block inside the detail panel.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #262c37; background: rgba(26,31,40,0.5); padding: 12px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgba(232,234,237,0.5); } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #e8eaed; }

components.name: Map Fire Marker
components.description: MapLibre circle layer representing a fire's origin point; radius and stroke both grow on selection.

narrative.overview: WildfireWatch reads like the main display wall of a night-shift operations room: a near-black world map as the permanent canvas, glowing hotspots as the only warm light source, and every floating panel a piece of glass instrumentation hovering over that canvas rather than a page of content sitting beside it. The dark theme is the primary, intentional world — light mode exists as a daylight-shift variant, not the default identity. Nothing on screen competes with the fire data for attention. Chrome (top bar, legend, side panel, ad slots) is deliberately quiet — translucent, blurred, low-contrast — so the map's heatmap glow and burned-area borders are always the brightest, most saturated things visible. Ad slots are the most visually recessive element in the system on purpose: dashed borders, muted fill, uppercase micro-label. They must never be mistaken for data. Component language is tactile and precise: crisp pill shapes, confident status-color contrast, glass surfaces that behave like real HUD panels built for fast scanning under pressure, not a soft consumer-app feel.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: void-black canvas, glass-panel chrome, glow-driven depth instead of drop shadows.
One color language for meaning (the four-step severity ramp) — never introduce a second accent hue for decoration.
Floating, translucent surfaces (top bar, legend, side panel) read as instruments layered over the map, not as a separate page.
Ad slots are structurally and visually separated from data at every density.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: All status/severity meaning flows through exactly one four-step ramp (Amber Watch → Signal Amber → Alert Red → Critical Crimson) plus the single Resolved Emerald exception. No other hue is ever added for “visual interest.”

rules.name: The Uppercase Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Any label introducing a data group is uppercase, tracked, and rendered at ~50% text opacity relative to body copy — it organizes without competing.

rules.name: The Glow-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: When something needs to feel “elevated” or “urgent,” reach for glow (blur + saturated color) before reaching for a drop shadow. Shadows are structural (separate this panel from that map); glow is meaningful (this is where the fire is).

dos: Do keep dark as the default, primary world; treat light mode as a secondary daylight-shift variant, not co-equal.
Do route all status/severity meaning through the One Ramp (plus Resolved Emerald) — never invent a new hue for a new state.
Do use glass (blur + translucency) for chrome that floats over the map; reach for glow (blur + saturated color), not drop shadow, when something needs to feel urgent or elevated.
Do keep ad slots visually recessive (dashed border, muted fill, micro-label) and structurally separate from data cards at every breakpoint.
Do show status and severity as a paired badge, never status alone.
donts: Don't let mock/synthetic data look or read as indistinguishable from real live data — no fabricated "LIVE" indicators or real-time-looking timestamps beyond what the mock generator actually produces.
Don't add a second decorative accent color outside the severity ramp.
Don't make drop shadow the primary elevation cue on the map or its overlays — glow and blur carry that job here.
Don't give an ad slot the same card treatment (solid fill, solid border, drop shadow) as a data card; the dashed/muted treatment is the whole point.
